office.name: Office of the General Manager, Cache Valley Transit District (Connect Public Transit)
office.place: Cache Valley Transit District, doing business as Connect Public Transit; administration and maintenance facility at 3021 N. 300 W., North Logan, Utah 84341. Service area Lewiston to Hyrum in Cache County, Utah, with one commuter route to Franklin County, Idaho.
office.remit: A small public transit district (a special district under Utah Code Title 17B, Chapter 2a, Part 8, the Public Transit District Act) funded mainly by a local sales tax of 0.25% plus federal (FTA Section 5307, 5339) and state grants. Fare-free fixed-route bus service Monday-Saturday (the Loop and about 14 numbered routes), no Sunday service, and Call-A-Ride, the ADA complementary paratransit service for riders certified as unable to use the fixed routes. A nine-member board of trustees, appointed by the county and member cities, adopts the budget, approves service changes and larger contracts, and appoints the general manager; the general manager runs operations, staff and day-to-day procurement within board-set limits. Monthly board meetings, fourth Wednesday, 5:30 p.m., in the boardroom at the administration building.

succession.rule: Utah Code 17B-2a-811 (Public Transit District Act): the board of trustees of a small public transit district shall appoint a general manager (and may appoint a chief executive officer); the appointment is by the affirmative vote of a majority of all members of the board and is based on the person's qualifications and experience; the appointee need not be a Utah resident at the time of appointment; the general manager serves at the pleasure of the board for an indefinite term and may be removed by a resolution adopted by a majority of all members. Connect's own site: 'the Board employs a CEO/General Manager'.
succession.timeline: The previous general manager retired; last day Fri Sept 4, 2026. The finance director was acting general manager Sept 5-13. Special board meeting Wed Sept 9, 2026, 5:30 p.m.: the board voted 9-0 to appoint Dana Whitcomb and approved her employment agreement. Start date Mon Sept 14, 2026.
sources: Utah Code 17B-2a-811, Appointment of general manager or chief executive officer (codes.findlaw.com/ut/title-17b-limited-purpose-local-government-entities-special-districts/ut-code-sect-17b-2a-811/ and le.utah.gov Title 17B Chapter 2a Part 8), checked 2026-10-07.
Utah Code 17B-2a-802 definitions ('general manager' means a person appointed by the board of trustees of a small public transit district), via law.justia.com, checked 2026-10-07.
rideconnectutah.gov/faq (nine-member board appointed by member entities; board employs the CEO/General Manager), checked 2026-10-07.
